title: Prediction-Augmented Trees for Reliable Statistical Inference
abstract: arXiv:2510.16937v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Machine learning (ML) is increasingly central to scientific discovery, but translating ML predictions into rigorous scientific claims still requires statistical inference on gold-standard labeled data. A setting that has emerged across the sciences provides the analyst with a small labeled sample, a much larger unlabeled sample, and a pre-trained predictor, with the goal of constructing a confidence interval for a quantity of interest, as was formalized in Angelopoulos et al. (2023). In this ML-driven scientific discovery literature, labeled data is typically the binding constraint on precision while computation is comparatively unconstrained, motivating the design question of how additional computation can extract more inferential value from a fixed labeled set, a fixed unlabeled set, and a fixed predictor.   To address this question, we propose the Prediction-Augmented Residual Tree (PART) estimator. PART takes the same input

translated_title: 用于可靠统计推断的预测增强树
translated_abstract: 机器学习（ML）在科学发现中正扮演着越来越核心的角色，但要将机器学习的预测转化为严谨的科学结论，仍然需要基于金标准标注数据进行统计推断。科学领域中已出现一种常见的研究设置：分析者拥有一个较小的标注样本、一个大得多的未标注样本以及一个预训练的预测器，目标是针对感兴趣的量构建置信区间，这一定义方式由 Angelopoulos 等人（2023）正式提出。在这一机器学习驱动的科学发现文献中，标注数据通常是精度的约束瓶颈，而计算资源相对不受限制，这引出了一个设计问题：如何利用额外的计算，从固定的标注数据集、固定的未标注数据集和固定的预测器中提取更多的推断价值。为回答这一问题，我们提出了预测增强残差树（PART）估计器。PART 接受相同的输入……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了预测增强残差树（PART）估计器，通过利用额外的计算从固定的标注数据、未标注数据和预训练预测器中挖掘更多推断价值，从而构建更精确的置信区间，提升统计推断的可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Prediction-Augmented Residual Tree (PART) estimator, which leverages additional computation to extract more inferential value from fixed labeled data, unlabeled data, and a pre-trained predictor, enabling more precise confidence intervals for reliable statistical inference.
